newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Brasmotor still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brasmotor still a buy.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch & Co reiterated its buy rating on shares of Brasmotor, a Brazilian appliance and electrical household goods maker, in the intermediate and long term.
-- In a report, the brokerage said Brasmotor, Latin America's largest white-goods producer, continues to perform immpressively.

-- As a result, Merrill Lynch raised its 1996 earnings estimate to 104 million reais, or 39.20 reais per share, compared with an earlier estimate of 74 million reais. It raised its 1997 estimate to 135 million reais, or 50.79 reais, from an earlier estimate of 100 million reais.

-- Merrill Lynch said it was raising its estimates because of stronger-than-expected second-quarter results, fueled by a solid performance from the company's Multibras appliance unit. It also cited favorable market conditions and economic trends.
-- "Selling at an attractive valuation and favored by a positive industry outlook, we continue to think BMT is one of the most attractive stocks today in Brazil," the brokerage said.
-- Brasmotor preferred was off 3.89 reais at 350.11 reais at 1645 local/1945 GMT on the Sao Paulo stock market.
